name: devstash

scripts.qa: pnpm qa:security && pnpm qa:responsive && pnpm qa:a11y

//pnpm: CI is pinned to pnpm 9 (.github/workflows/*.yml), which reads overrides/auditConfig from HERE, not pnpm-workspace.yaml — that's a 10+-only location. Overrides force patched versions of transitive deps pulled in only by devDependencies (@lhci/cli's inquirer/tmp/socks chain, eslint's own minimatch) that `pnpm audit --audit-level=high` flags high-severity; none are reachable from anything that ships. Each is upper-bounded to the major line already proven compatible, not just patched — an open '>=X' floor let pnpm jump brace-expansion to 5.x (broke `pnpm lint`: eslint's minimatch@3 calls it with the old v1.x shape) and js-yaml to 5.x (removed the safeLoad()/safeDump() API scripts/seo/check-metadata.mjs calls directly). extract-zip is deliberately NOT overridden and instead ignored via auditConfig: its advisory (GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv) asks for >=2.0.2, but 2.0.1 is still the latest version actually published to npm — there's no real fix to pin to yet.
//browserslist: Modern targets so Next/SWC stops shipping ES2019-2022 polyfills for OUR OWN source in transpiled-output-that-respects-this-config. Doesn't touch @next/polyfill-module specifically — confirmed by direct build test (2026-08) that it ships its fixed Array.at/flat/flatMap/Object.fromEntries/hasOwn/String.trimStart/trimEnd bundle regardless of this config; that's an open upstream Next.js limitation (vercel/next.js#86785), not something fixable from project config. ~14KiB, not worth chasing further.
